changelog: Score breakdowns name a `customField:<key>` dimension by its question label (`GET /api/admin/matching/custom-fields`), and the rule editor flags and removes rules over a question that is no longer matchable instead of failing the save with a bare error (#1803 follow-ups).

en: Match explanations now show your own questions by name, and a rule whose question was switched off can be cleared in one click.
tr: Eşleşme açıklamaları artık kendi sorularınızı adıyla gösteriyor; sorusu kapatılan bir kural tek tıkla temizlenebiliyor.
de: Match-Erklärungen zeigen Ihre eigenen Fragen jetzt beim Namen, und eine Regel, deren Frage abgeschaltet wurde, lässt sich mit einem Klick entfernen.
